description:
Simple but addictive gameplay. Roll the knives and cut everything on your way.  

Each level is made for your pleasure and happiness. Feel the real ASMR every second you play. Slicing the fruit can be so satisfying. Try it for yourself.

Find the right rhythm and make the gameplay smooth and perfect!  

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Take your time and enjoy the game!
name: Slicy Flips
intro: Slicing is so easy and the pleasure is real
